observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with an 18-55mm lens attached, placed on a white box with 'McSteve Online Gadget Store' printed on it. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D90' clearly visible on the top and side, respectively.
The lens has 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55G VR' engraved on the barrel, matching the seller's claim.
The camera body shows signs of wear: dust, scratches, and minor scuffs, especially on the grip and top panel.
The screen is off in photo 1, and the shutter count is not visible in any photo.
No power cord, battery, or charger is visible in any photo.
The background in all photos shows a store environment with shelves and boxed electronics, suggesting a retail or second-hand setting.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D90 DSLR Camera With 18-55MM lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows Nikon D90 and 18-55mm lens; photo 1 confirms the lens model.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in operation. The screen is off in photo 1, and no proof of functionality is provided.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
